en: The image shows a formal stone monument set in a forested, mountainous area. The focal point is a statue of a man in a military or scouting uniform with a dog at his side, standing on a pedestal at the center of a curved stone balustrade. Behind the statue is a stone wall engraved with bas-relief portraits. There are flowers at the base, indicating it is a place of commemoration. There is no visible text in the image.
